Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1246
Claimant:
Justin Stuart
Adjuster:
Darin Tyler
2-18-25
Claim opened after the insured reported a rear-end collision at a signalized intersection. The claimant's vehicle was
struck from behind while stopped, and the claim was assigned for review the same day.
4-13-25
Confirmed that the driver of the insured vehicle is named on the policy and that coverage was active at the time of
loss. No issues with the policy have been identified.
5-17-25
Reviewed the first set of photos from the scene. They show the rear bumper and trunk area of the claimant's vehicle,
consistent with the described impact. Independent witnesses were not identified.
5-18-25
Rceorded the claimant's account by phone. The claimant described the collision and reported a shoulder injury, and
the account matched the original report in its main points.
6-5-25
Requested prior claims history for the vehicle. No earlier damage to the vehicle has been identified, and nothing in
the file suggests the damage predates the policy start.
6-12-25
Obtained the repair estimate. The damage is mostly in line with the described impact, with the rear panel and bumper
as the primary areas affected.
6-23-25
Reviewed the medical records provided through counsel. The shoulder injury fits the kind and force of the collision
well, and no earlier injury to the same body area is known.
8-1-25
Spoke with claimant's counsel, who confirmed representation and asked that all contact go through their office.
Counsel provided the claimant's account, which matches what the claimant told us in earlier conversations.
8-11-25
Noted that the file does not make clear where in the vehicle the claimant was seated at impact. Counsel was asked to
clarify, and a follow-up request was sent.
8-20-25
Reviewed treatment records. Care followed a usual course and tapered as the claimant improved, with no unusual
gaps or escalations noted.
8-21-25
Summarized the file for supervisor review. Liability and damage details are consistent with the reported loss, and the
seating position question is the only open item pending counsel's response.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
